answer: Nobody is waved through free: a 5-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one is the price, and the yarrow never covers it twice. No Sponsored clerk workshop licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence clerks carry after desk audits is why it holds. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The jetty is on the docket. One willow, one entry.
